## About the Event

The Department of Information Technology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (Autonomous) is organizing a two-day National level students’ technical symposiumYUKTI-2026on 16thand 17thOctober 2026. Technical events such as Paper Presentation, Poster Presentation, Project Expo, Debug the Code, Code Rush and Reverse Engineering are organized by the students of IT under the guidance of the faculty of the Department.
